propositions: A new persistent store must record peer confirmations (vendor link id, direction, pass id, confirmed-at timestamp) keyed by (source_local_id, target_local_id, relation) to distinguish never-pushed local links from peer-deleted ones in the inbound removal path.

The outbound link creation seam must invoke a link_confirm callback after set_relationship succeeds, capturing the vendor link id from the returned mapping and translating Jira keys to local ids via binding_store reverse lookup.
Confirmation store changes must be staged in both _rel_files and _tracked_basenames to survive snapshot compaction and not be silently dropped by the per-file idempotency guard.
Unbound targets (where binding_store.get_local_id returns None) must skip recording entirely to avoid persisting vendor keys in local-id fields.
The link_confirm callback must be optional and exception-safe: any callback failure must be logged and swallowed to prevent breaking already-landed outbound links or corrupting link count metrics.
Store load must be fail-open: corrupt or absent peer_confirmations.json yields an empty store without raising, allowing subsequent passes or snapshots to supply backfill.
